companion_article.title: A Real-Robot Dataset for Assessing Transferability of Learned Dynamics Models
companion_article.locator: Secs. IV, IV-A and IV-B, Fig. 2. Defines units, 1000 Hz, GP excitation with protective intervention, and PD sine tracking. The repository README also says 0.001 seconds and 14000 samples in 14 s; its conflicting “1 Hz” string is a typo.
companion_article.fulltext_access: The search-service PDF reader returned the MPI author-hosted PDF. The ELLIS institutional mirror returned a 7-page PDF through both the web reader and direct HTTPS; text was extracted with pdftotext and the clock rate, protection layer and full-reference definitions checked. The direct MPI URL returned HTML to the shell.

evidence: Public full text, both complete real experiment archives, and one overlapping validation split verified against the matching rollout and time slice in the closed-loop full file. No simulated rows included.
selection: Both physical *_full.npz archives in the v1.0 deposit. Included the Sines validation file only to verify column order, prefix and release splits. Sim_Sines and overlapping splits excluded from all totals.
meaning: desired_torques and constrained_torques are compared cell-by-cell. The author data loader uses constrained_torques as model actions. measured_torques is the recorded observation channel; the source does not establish an independently calibrated output force sensor for this analysis.
